description: First independent Trellis Lite release for Codex and OMP with bounded P/V/U execution profiles
changelog:
**Trellis Lite fork:**
- Supports only Codex and OMP.
- Adds P0–P3 change scope, shared frontend/backend V0–V3 code verification, and independent U0–U3 browser/UI verification.
- Uses Ego Lite by default for UI verification and requires explicit selection for Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or project E2E tools.
- Makes checker report mode optional, read-only, and single-pass.
- Renames the CLI to `trellis-lite` / `tll` so it can coexist with official Trellis.
notes: No user-data migration is required. Existing tasks, specs, workspace journals, and session history are preserved.
